name: reporter_cluster_bars_handbook
description: Complete handbook test for Bars family reporters: xy_bars (L1-L15), cs_bars (L1-L10). 25 layouts total, each in its own category.
source:
# ========================================================================
# Bars Family Handbook — All Layouts
# Assets: SPY, QQQ, DIA | Timeframe: 1D
# ========================================================================

# === Market Data ===
src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c
high = src.h
low = src.l
volume = src.v

# === Core Derived Series ===
daily_ret = (close - (close >> 1)) / (close >> 1)
cum_ret = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(daily_ret)
sma_20 = sma(period=20)(close)
sma_50 = sma(period=50)(close)
sma_200 = sma(period=200)(close)
rsi_14 = rsi(period=14)(close)
ts = index()

# Running count
ones = close / close
bar_count = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(ones)

# Date components
month_num = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.month)(ts)
year_num = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.year)(ts)
day_of_week = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.day_of_week)(ts)

# Monthly return proxy: last trading day of month flag
month_next = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.month)(ts >> 1)
month_end = 1.0 if month_num != month_next else 0.0 / 0.0
monthly_ret = daily_ret * month_end
nan_flag = monthly_ret / monthly_ret
month_label = month_num * nan_flag

# Quartile bins for bar grouping
ret_bucket = 1.0 if daily_ret > 0.01 else (2.0 if daily_ret > 0 else (3.0 if daily_ret > -0.01 else 4.0))

# Average volume ratio
vol_ratio = volume / sma(period=20)(volume)
avg_vol_ratio = sma(period=60)(vol_ratio)

# ========================================================================
# XY BARS (xy_bars) — L1 through L13
# ========================================================================

# L1: Simple labeled mode — Monthly returns
xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.labeled,
    title='L1: Average Return by Month',
    category='01 xy_bars L1: Labeled Mode',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    color_by_value=True,
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ])
)(monthly_ret, label=month_label)

# L2: Series mode — Each column becomes a bar
xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.series,
    title='L2: SMA Snapshots',
    category='02 xy_bars L2: Series Mode',
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='SMA 20', color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='SMA 50', color=Color.Indigo),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='SMA 200', color=Color.Gray)
    ])
)(values=(sma_20, sma_50, sma_200))

# L3: Grouped mode — Stack groups as x-axis categories
xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.series,
    title='L3: Return Buckets by Half',
    category='03 xy_bars L3: Grouped Mode',
    agg=AggregationType.Sum,
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Positive', color=Color.Green, stack='> 1%'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Negative', color=Color.Red, stack='> 1%'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Positive', color=Color.Green, stack='0 to 1%'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Negative', color=Color.Red, stack='0 to 1%')
    ])
)(values=(ones * (1.0 if daily_ret > 0.01 else 0.0), ones * (1.0 if daily_ret < -0.01 else 0.0), ones * (1.0 if daily_ret > 0 else 0.0) * (1.0 if daily_ret <= 0.01 else 0.0), ones * (1.0 if daily_ret < 0 else 0.0) * (1.0 if daily_ret >= -0.01 else 0.0)))

# Helper: up/down day flags (used by L4, L5, L13, L14)
up_day_early = 1.0 if daily_ret > 0 else 0.0
down_day_early = 1.0 if daily_ret <= 0 else 0.0

# L4: Normal stacked bars — Up vs Down days by day of week
xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.labeled,
    title='L4: Up vs Down Days by Weekday (Stacked)',
    category='04 xy_bars L4: Stacked',
    agg=AggregationType.Sum,
    stack_type=StackType.NormalStack,
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.DayOfWeek,
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Up Days', color=Color.Green),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Down Days', color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(values=(up_day_early, down_day_early), label=day_of_week)

# L5: 100% stacked bars — Up vs Down days by weekday (pct split)
xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.labeled,
    title='L5: Up vs Down Day Split by Weekday',
    category='05 xy_bars L5: Percent Stack',
    agg=AggregationType.Sum,
    stack_type=StackType.PercentStack,
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.DayOfWeek,
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Up Days', color=Color.Green),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Down Days', color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(values=(up_day_early, down_day_early), label=day_of_week)

# L6: Horizontal bars
xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.labeled,
    title='L6: Horizontal Monthly Returns',
    category='06 xy_bars L6: Horizontal',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    vertical=False,
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    color_by_value=True,
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat
)(monthly_ret, label=month_label)

# L7: Color by value
xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.labeled,
    title='L7: Day-of-Week Returns (Color by Value)',
    category='07 xy_bars L7: Color By Value',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.DayOfWeek,
    color_by_value=True,
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=3
)(daily_ret, label=day_of_week)

# L8: With reference lines
xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.labeled,
    title='L8: Monthly Returns with Thresholds',
    category='08 xy_bars L8: Reference Lines',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        ReferenceLine(value=0.5, title='Target', color=Color.Green, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ])
)(monthly_ret, label=month_label)

# L9: With overlay lines
xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.labeled,
    title='L9: Monthly Returns with Avg Overlay',
    category='09 xy_bars L9: Overlay Lines',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    color_by_value=True,
    overlay_series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Cumulative Avg', color=Color.Orange, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, agg=AggregationType.Mean)
    ])
)(monthly_ret, label=month_label, overlays=monthly_ret)

# L10: Data labels disabled
xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.labeled,
    title='L10: Monthly Returns (No Labels)',
    category='10 xy_bars L10: No Data Labels',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    data_labels=False,
    color_by_value=True,
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat
)(monthly_ret, label=month_label)

# L11: Y plot bands
xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.labeled,
    title='L11: Monthly Returns with Target Zone',
    category='11 xy_bars L11: Y Plot Bands',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_plot_bands=PlotBandSchema(bands=[
        PlotBand(from=-0.5, to=0.0, color=Color.Red, opacity=0.1, label='Negative Zone'),
        PlotBand(from=0.0, to=0.5, color=Color.Green, opacity=0.1, label='Target Zone')
    ])
)(monthly_ret, label=month_label)

# L12: Bar width + padding control
xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.labeled,
    title='L12: Tight Bars (Custom Spacing)',
    category='12 xy_bars L12: Custom Spacing',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    point_padding=0.02,
    group_padding=0.05,
    border_radius=0.3,
    color_by_value=True,
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat
)(monthly_ret, label=month_label)

# Helper: up/down day counts per month
up_day = 1.0 if daily_ret > 0 else 0.0
down_day = 1.0 if daily_ret <= 0 else 0.0

# L13: Stack labels on labeled stacked bars — up vs down day counts
xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.labeled,
    title='L13: Up vs Down Days by Month (Stack Labels)',
    category='13 xy_bars L13: Stack Labels',
    agg=AggregationType.Sum,
    stack_type=StackType.NormalStack,
    stack_labels=True,
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Up Days', color=Color.Green),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Down Days', color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(values=(up_day, down_day), label=month_num)

# Helper: intraday range as pct
intraday_range = (high - low) / close

# L14: Multi-series labeled — Stacked by month
# Up days vs down days stacked per month (same scale: counts)
xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.labeled,
    title='L14: Up vs Down Days by Month (Stacked)',
    category='14 xy_bars L14: Labeled Stacked',
    agg=AggregationType.Sum,
    stack_type=StackType.NormalStack,
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Up Days', color=Color.Green),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Down Days', color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(values=(up_day, down_day), label=month_num)

# L15: Multi-series labeled — Grouped by month
# Avg return vs avg intraday range side by side (both small pct scale)
xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.labeled,
    title='L15: Avg Return vs Intraday Range by Month',
    category='15 xy_bars L15: Labeled Grouped',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Avg Daily Return', color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Avg Intraday Range', color=Color.Orange)
    ]),
    y_axis_dp=2
)(values=(daily_ret, intraday_range), label=month_num)

# L16: Sort by value — Monthly returns sorted descending
xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.labeled,
    title='L16: Monthly Returns (Sorted High to Low)',
    category='16 xy_bars L16: Sort By Value',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    sort_by_value='Descending',
    color_by_value=True,
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ])
)(monthly_ret, label=month_label)

# ========================================================================
# CROSS-SECTIONAL BARS (cs_bars) — L1 through L11
# ========================================================================

# L1: Simple mode — One bar per asset
cs_bars(
    mode=CSBarMode.simple,
    title='L1: Last Close by Asset',
    category='14 cs_bars L1: Simple Mode',
    agg=AggregationType.Last
)(values=close)

# L2: Color by value
cs_bars(
    mode=CSBarMode.simple,
    title='L2: Cumulative Return (Color by Value)',
    category='15 cs_bars L2: Color By Value',
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    color_by_value=True,
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat
)(values=cum_ret)

# L3: With custom colors
cs_bars(
    mode=CSBarMode.simple,
    title='L3: Last RSI with Colors',
    category='16 cs_bars L3: Custom Colors',
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    colors=[Color.Blue, Color.Indigo, Color.Gray]
)(values=rsi_14)

# L4: Grouped mode (multiple values per asset)
cs_bars(
    mode=CSBarMode.grouped,
    title='L4: SMA Comparison by Asset',
    category='17 cs_bars L4: Grouped Mode',
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    series_names=['SMA 20', 'SMA 50', 'SMA 200']
)(values=(sma_20, sma_50, sma_200))

# L5: With reference lines
cs_bars(
    mode=CSBarMode.simple,
    title='L5: RSI with Threshold Lines',
    category='18 cs_bars L5: Reference Lines',
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=30, title='Oversold', color=Color.Green, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        ReferenceLine(value=70, title='Overbought', color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ])
)(values=rsi_14)

# L6: Horizontal bars
cs_bars(
    mode=CSBarMode.simple,
    title='L6: Horizontal Asset Returns',
    category='19 cs_bars L6: Horizontal',
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    vertical=False,
    color_by_value=True,
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat
)(values=cum_ret)

# L7: Y plot bands
cs_bars(
    mode=CSBarMode.simple,
    title='L7: RSI with Zone Bands',
    category='20 cs_bars L7: Y Plot Bands',
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    y_plot_bands=PlotBandSchema(bands=[
        PlotBand(from=0, to=30, color=Color.Green, opacity=0.1, label='Oversold'),
        PlotBand(from=70, to=100, color=Color.Red, opacity=0.1, label='Overbought')
    ])
)(values=rsi_14)

# L8: With overlay lines
cs_bars(
    mode=CSBarMode.simple,
    title='L8: Close with Average Overlay',
    category='21 cs_bars L8: Overlay Lines',
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    overlay_series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Mean Close', color=Color.Orange, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, agg=AggregationType.Mean)
    ])
)(values=close, overlays=close)

# L9: Label-as-x-axis — Avg return by month, assets grouped
cs_bars(
    mode=CSBarMode.stacked,
    title='L9: Avg Return by Month (Assets Grouped)',
    category='22 cs_bars L9: Label-as-X Grouped',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    label_as_x_axis=True,
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2
)(values=monthly_ret, label=month_label)

# L10: Label-as-x-axis stacked — Avg return by month, assets stacked
cs_bars(
    mode=CSBarMode.stacked,
    title='L10: Avg Return by Month (Assets Stacked)',
    category='23 cs_bars L10: Label-as-X Stacked',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    label_as_x_axis=True,
    stack_type=StackType.NormalStack,
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2
)(values=monthly_ret, label=month_label)

# L11: Simple mode sorted — Assets ranked by cumulative return
cs_bars(
    mode=CSBarMode.simple,
    title='L11: Assets Ranked by Return (Descending)',
    category='24 cs_bars L11: Sort By Value',
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    sort_by_value='Descending',
    color_by_value=True,
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2
)(values=cum_ret)

# ========================================================================
# XY_BARS — AGG DIVERSITY (15 values)
# ========================================================================

xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.labeled,
    agg=AggregationType.Min,
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.DayOfWeek,
    category='AD xy_bars agg=Min'
)(daily_ret, label=day_of_week)

xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.labeled,
    agg=AggregationType.Max,
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.DayOfWeek,
    category='AD xy_bars agg=Max'
)(daily_ret, label=day_of_week)

xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.labeled,
    agg=AggregationType.Median,
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.DayOfWeek,
    category='AD xy_bars agg=Median'
)(daily_ret, label=day_of_week)

xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.labeled,
    agg=AggregationType.Std,
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.DayOfWeek,
    category='AD xy_bars agg=Std'
)(daily_ret, label=day_of_week)

xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.labeled,
    agg=AggregationType.Count,
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.DayOfWeek,
    category='AD xy_bars agg=Count'
)(daily_ret, label=day_of_week)

xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.labeled,
    agg=AggregationType.First,
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.DayOfWeek,
    category='AD xy_bars agg=First'
)(daily_ret, label=day_of_week)

xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.labeled,
    agg=AggregationType.All,
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.DayOfWeek,
    category='AD xy_bars agg=All'
)(daily_ret, label=day_of_week)

xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.labeled,
    agg=AggregationType.Any,
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.DayOfWeek,
    category='AD xy_bars agg=Any'
)(daily_ret, label=day_of_week)

xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.labeled,
    agg=AggregationType.CountDistinct,
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.DayOfWeek,
    category='AD xy_bars agg=CountDistinct'
)(daily_ret, label=day_of_week)

xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.labeled,
    agg=AggregationType.Kurtosis,
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.DayOfWeek,
    category='AD xy_bars agg=Kurtosis'
)(daily_ret, label=day_of_week)

xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.labeled,
    agg=AggregationType.Mode,
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.DayOfWeek,
    category='AD xy_bars agg=Mode'
)(daily_ret, label=day_of_week)

xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.labeled,
    agg=AggregationType.Product,
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.DayOfWeek,
    category='AD xy_bars agg=Product'
)(daily_ret, label=day_of_week)

xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.labeled,
    agg=AggregationType.Quantile,
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.DayOfWeek,
    category='AD xy_bars agg=Quantile'
)(daily_ret, label=day_of_week)

xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.labeled,
    agg=AggregationType.Skew,
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.DayOfWeek,
    category='AD xy_bars agg=Skew'
)(daily_ret, label=day_of_week)

xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.labeled,
    agg=AggregationType.Var,
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.DayOfWeek,
    category='AD xy_bars agg=Var'
)(daily_ret, label=day_of_week)

# ========================================================================
# CS_BARS — AGG DIVERSITY (16 values)
# ========================================================================

cs_bars(
    mode=CSBarMode.simple,
    agg=AggregationType.Sum,
    category='AD cs_bars agg=Sum'
)(values=daily_ret)

cs_bars(
    mode=CSBarMode.simple,
    agg=AggregationType.Min,
    category='AD cs_bars agg=Min'
)(values=daily_ret)

cs_bars(
    mode=CSBarMode.simple,
    agg=AggregationType.Max,
    category='AD cs_bars agg=Max'
)(values=daily_ret)

cs_bars(
    mode=CSBarMode.simple,
    agg=AggregationType.Median,
    category='AD cs_bars agg=Median'
)(values=daily_ret)

cs_bars(
    mode=CSBarMode.simple,
    agg=AggregationType.Std,
    category='AD cs_bars agg=Std'
)(values=daily_ret)

cs_bars(
    mode=CSBarMode.simple,
    agg=AggregationType.Count,
    category='AD cs_bars agg=Count'
)(values=daily_ret)

cs_bars(

    agg=AggregationType.First,
    category='AD cs_bars agg=First'
)(values=daily_ret)

cs_bars(
    mode=CSBarMode.simple,
    agg=AggregationType.All,
    category='AD cs_bars agg=All'
)(values=daily_ret)

cs_bars(
    mode=CSBarMode.simple,
    agg=AggregationType.Any,
    category='AD cs_bars agg=Any'
)(values=daily_ret)

cs_bars(
    mode=CSBarMode.simple,
    agg=AggregationType.CountDistinct,
    category='AD cs_bars agg=CountDistinct'
)(values=daily_ret)

cs_bars(
    mode=CSBarMode.simple,
    agg=AggregationType.Kurtosis,
    category='AD cs_bars agg=Kurtosis'
)(values=daily_ret)

cs_bars(

    agg=AggregationType.Mode,
    category='AD cs_bars agg=Mode'
)(values=daily_ret)

cs_bars(

    agg=AggregationType.Product,
    category='AD cs_bars agg=Product'
)(values=daily_ret)

    category='AD cs_bars agg=Quantile'
)(values=daily_ret)

)(values=daily_ret)

cs_bars(

    agg=AggregationType.Var,
    category='AD cs_bars agg=Var'
)(values=daily_ret)
